messages:
jen: Kicking off HIPAA POC convo with MedSecure. They want a 30-day POC, throughput profile below. Need capacity plan + pricing ASAP.
sam: Please confirm PHI handling and whether they'll accept a BAA + VPC/KMS. Also need model variant for sizing.
jen: PHI yes (PHI stays in convo payloads). Baseline ~200 RPS, 100-150 tokens per call. Regular spikes to ~1.2k RPS for 5-10m every 1-2 hours. Targets: p50 <120ms, p99 <800ms.
maria: For that spike shape, reserved pool + autoscale makes sense. Quick thought: sustained 200 RPS is small, spikes drive most capacity. We should size for peak with autoscale and a fast prewarm.
sam: Which model are they evaluating? quantized/13B fallback?
jen: They want redwood/llama-70b-quant (q4_8) for quality, but open to a distilled 13B as a fallback during heavy bursts. Context length ~512 tokens.
oliver: Fallback policy recommended: route to 13B when queue > X or model latency > 500ms to protect SLOs; degrade gracefully with quality gates.
maria: Sizing notes: 70B q4_8, batch=16, KV cache expected — conservative throughput per A100-ish GPU ~250-300 RPS. So 1.2k -> 5 GPUs. On A10G expect ~180-220 RPS -> 6-7 GPUs.
sam: For a commit offer we can propose reserved baseline 2 GPUs + autoscale to 6 (burst) with prewarm credits for expected windows. Procurement asked delta vs flat reserved 6.
jen: Procurement wants numbers: monthly cost for (a) reserved 6 GPUs, (b) reserved 2 + burst credits/overage. Include expected overage rules.
sam: I'll run a quick cost model and flag assumptions (GPU type, commit length). Also include quantized 13B fallback cost to show savings during spikes.
maria: Operationally: autoscale cooldown 180s tends to thrash on short bursts — recommend 300s cooldown and prewarm window of 5-10m before predicted spikes. Also enable prefix/KV caching and longer token cache retention.
jen: Security questionnaire items: KMS/HSM support, BAA, SOC2 evidence, audit log retention, VPC peering, private endpoints. Legal needs data flow diagram and encryption-at-rest details.
oliver: I'll draft the minimal data flow diagram and fallback quality gate doc. Need to define acceptable quality delta (ROUGE/BLEU or human eval) for fallback.
sam: Loading harness needed. Here's a simple k6 snippet to simulate baseline+burst (will flesh out):
```
import http from 'k6/http';
import { sleep } from 'k6';
export let options = { stages: [ { duration: '10m', target: 200 }, { duration: '5m', target: 1200 }, { duration: '5m', target: 200 } ] };
export default function() { http.post('https://api.redwood/v1/generate', '{"input":"test"}', { headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer <TOKEN>' } }); sleep(0.01); }
```
sam: Use that to validate preheat + autoscale settings. We should test with both 70B and 13B to confirm routing.
maria: Timeline check: customer wants start 2023-03-10 (they wrote local date). We need signed PO + legal cleared by 2023-03-08. SRE needs 48h to allocate reserved GPUs and configure peering. Can we meet it?
jen: I'll chase procurement/legal. If we miss timeline, propose a soft start with reduced SLA.
oliver: Primary enterprise blockers: signed BAA, network peering approval, commit sizing sign-off, and fallback quality acceptance. Also need clarity on retention windows for logs (they want 7 years?).
jen: Action items: sam -> pricing delta + finalized k6 script; maria -> draft autoscale/preheat config + runbook; oliver -> fallback quality gates and dataflow diagram; jen -> chase legal/procurement. Check-in tomorrow 10:00am PT.
sam: on it :thumbsup: 
maria: I'll post the draft runbook here EOD.
devops-bot: Reservation created (req-8921) pending approval.
jen: Thanks all — I'll update once legal confirms the BAA.
